finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Other parents who had children before the system and now had ones after the initiation talk about how different it is. And not just how it’s obviously different having a kid with supernatural abilities, but how fast it now feels like they grow up. In reality, it’s still around the same, but it really doesn’t feel that way,” Maja said, continuing to observe the lawn and the two goofballs fighting on it. “I suppose a year just isn’t as long of a time as it used to be.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Yeah... you know, it does feel a little weird,” Maja said with a sigh. “I know it’s something all parents say, but I feel like now it’s more true than ever.”
